## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the new infrastructure capability or automation.

## Problem Context
What problem does this solve? Describe how it improves deployment efficiency, reliability, or cost management.

## Proposed Solution
Explain how this aligns with the infrastructure standards. Detail the services, tools, or configurations to adopt.

## Alternative Solutions considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Impact Analysis
* What environments are affected?
* Does this modify firewall settings or IAM roles?
* Estimated cost impact.
